title: Wally Wanka's Candygrams: Limb-N-Crunches
description: Wally Wanka's Candygrams: Limb-N-Crunches — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Wally Wanka

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 45 of Abaddon's Abysmal Limb-N-Crunches from The Embercore Path

Quest Reward: 10000 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Rose, Townston Commander, or Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable:  ?

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 45 of Abaddon's Abysmal Limb-N-Crunches and deliver them to Rose or Townston Commander or poor Ol' Chuck Pail.

Offer:

I think I have an idea to make money even though Abaddon took over my candy factory. One word: Candygrams! Wally Wanka's Candygrams! It has a nice ring to it, I must say. And since you are bringing me Abaddon's Abysmal candies I might as well do something with them so I can pay my monthly subscription fee.

Collect and deliver Abaddon's Abysmal Limb-N-Crunches to my oldest and most loyal customers: Rose or Townston Commander or poor Ol' Chuck Pail.

Turn-in:

You have something from Wally Wanka? What is it? It looks kind of creepy and seems...some what familiar...somehow. I'll try it though. Thanks!

Objectives:

  • Abaddon's Abysmal Limb-N-Crunch ×45

Level range: 40–100
